subject: AWS Marketplace listing: usage scenarios, pricing footnote, and demo plan
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helios-ai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Shaw <ben.shaw@aws-partners.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Product page + co-sell prep: Helios AI on AWS Marketplace

Evelyn / team —

Thanks again for taking this on. We're preparing our AWS Marketplace listing for Helios' Embedding & Retrieval service. Before we lock assets with AWS, Ben suggested a short review with Redwood to align messaging and co-sell readiness.

What's attached: product-page-draft.docx (initial copy), ami-screenshot.png (AMI tag preview), and a quick pricing spreadsheet. High-level asks:
- Confirm the hero one-liner reads clearly for a developer vs buyer audience
- Clear guidance on usage scenarios (real-time inference / batch embeddings) so customers land in the right trial/SKU
- Any necessary pricing footnote language AWS requires for per-request vs hourly billing
- Plan for a 30-min field demo for sales + a co-sell CTA (who from Redwood should join?)

We're aiming to submit the listing by next Friday (2026-04-10). Can you help prioritize the copy edits and finalize the trial SKU guidance?

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Partnerships, Helios AI
Sanjay@helios-ai.com
Attachment: product-page-draft.docx (docx)
Attachment: ami-screenshot.png (image)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@helios-ai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Product page + co-sell prep: Helios AI on AWS Marketplace

Hi Sanjay —

Appreciate the package; good first pass. Looping in Kimberly (marketplace copy) and Aditya (sales engineering) to align on messaging and the demo. Quick notes inline and next steps below.

Top-level: please split the hero and the sub-hero so buyers scanning the Marketplace see value immediately then developer callouts below the fold. I also recommend we avoid product jargon in the hero — lead with outcome ("Deploy embeddings at production scale for search & retrieval") instead of internal names.

Usage scenarios (please add short bullets):
- "Real-time semantic search" — low-latency inference with short sequences (focus on latency SLA)
- "Batch embeddings for large corpora" — high throughput, cheaper per-embedding path (show cost example)
- "Hybrid: prefix caching for conversation apps" — mention KV-cache compatibility (helps our runtime routing compatibility claim)

Pricing footnote: AWS likes explicit trial/usage language. Suggest: "Usage pricing shown reflects estimated per-1M embeddings and includes applicable AWS fees; contact sales for dedicated capacity pricing and private deployment options." Kimberly, please add the short footnote legal-approved phrasing.

Demo: Aditya can run the field demo. Proposed slots: Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PDT or Wed 2026-04-08 15:00 PDT. Sanjay, which works?

Deliverables & timeline:
- Kimberly to send one-line hero + 3 bullets (ETA: Mon 2026-04-06 EOD)
- Aditya to confirm demo slot and tech checklist (ETA: Mon 2026-04-06)
- Sanjay to update product-page-draft.docx with the AMI tag and trial SKU suggestion (ETA: Wed 2026-04-08)

We'll also attach the AWS-required pricing footnote and AMI tagging instructions before submission.

Thanks — talk soon.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0112

Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Product page + co-sell prep: Helios AI on AWS Marketplace

Thanks — I pulled the doc into the Drive and made a short set of copy edits. Key changes below and attached the pricing matrix with suggested footnotes.

Hero rewrite (one-liner):
"Deploy production-grade embeddings and retrieval at cloud scale — low-latency for search, high-throughput for batch analytics."

Sub-hero (two-sentence):
"Helios Embeddings & Retrieval provides vector search, semantic ranking, and production tooling optimized for hybrid workloads. Start with a free trial SKU and upgrade to dedicated capacity for predictable latency and throughput."

Usage bullets (short, scannable):
• Real-time semantic search — <50ms p95 for short queries (developer-friendly SDKs)
• Large-batch embeddings — cost-optimized pipelines for corpus-wide indexing
• Conversation augmentation — KV-cache compatible for stateful context retention

Pricing footnote (suggested language):
"Pricing shown is an estimate and excludes applicable AWS Marketplace fees. Actual charges vary by usage profile; contact Redwood or Helios for dedicated capacity pricing and enterprise invoicing options."

AMI / asset checklist: confirm AMI has seller-id tag (aws:SellerId) and marketplace-visibility set. Sanjay — your screenshot looks fine but please confirm the seller-id value in the AMI metadata.

I've attached pricing-matrix.csv with suggested mappings: trial SKU (free 14-day trial), pay-as-you-go per-1k embeddings, and dedicated capacity blocks.

Aditya — for the demo, happy to have you cover the following checklist: SDK quickstart, latency demo (short queries), and a walk-through of dedicated capacity benefits.

Sanjay — I'll push the doc edits to Drive and can finalize copy once you confirm the AMI seller-id and the preferred trial SKU.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing-matrix.csv (csv)

All —

Thanks for the rapid turnaround. From AWS-side: the proposed hero + bullets look clean and consistent with Marketplace best practices. A couple of small asks before final submission:
1) Ensure the pricing footnote includes the phrase "Marketplace fees may apply" (legal prefers this explicit callout).
2) Confirm the trial SKU will be available for the 14-day trial path in the Private Offers flow (Helios to confirm SKU id).
3) If you plan to include AMI screenshots, please also include the AMI manifest link (we'll need it for the listing verification).

Sanjay — once you confirm SKU + AMI seller-id, AWS can finalize the visibility check and publish the listing. Also happy to join the demo for internal field enablement — Tue 2026-04-07 10:00 PDT works for me.

Ben Shaw
Partner SA, AWS Marketplace
ben.shaw@aws-partners.com
